context: Request: every healthcare / life-sciences matter that turned on an FDA approval or clearance already granted, with supporting documents (experience list). Rubric: 1037-00003 (Solstice Biomedical, launch compliance review, 510(k) K232847) with a proof document, plus a precision criterion that permits only 1037-00003 and 1018-00005. All three runs also asserted 1018-00002 (Penterra/Zelvara OPDP inquiry); T1 added 1037-00004 and 1037-00006, T2 added 1013-00006.

runs.failure_point: It listed two extra matters whose documents mention an existing approval or authorization as turning on it.

first_error.why: Besides the two permitted matters it lists a drug-promotion inquiry and an asset sale whose transferred products had authorizations as matters that turned on a granted approval (evidence seen at [86]-[107]).
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [113] asked to confirm that the authorization was material to the asset deal; the agent re-read that agreement at [143] and kept it, and no review questioned the drug-promotion inquiry.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way, on precision at the write stage (over-inclusion): each found and cited the needed matter and the second permitted one, but also asserted a matter about an inquiry into promotion of an already approved drug, and T1 and T2 added matters whose documents merely mention an existing authorization. Discovery differed (file-name searches, store-wide scans that timed out, hand-picked shortlists), but every run reached the same candidates. No review questioned the shared extra matter; reviews pushed for wider coverage and for keeping the matter set, and only T2's review asked whether one extra matter's authorization was material, which the agent re-read and kept. Label notes were ignored on screening stages declared as listing reads (T0) or in-depth reads (T2).
